summary.text: The delivery worker received repeated HTTP 401 responses; the supplied credential export does not establish expiry.

impact.text: A failed delivery remained pending for retry; a later queue sample contained 42 pending messages.

observations.text: Two delivery attempts received HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Credential expiry and revocation state are unavailable in the redacted export.
The worker health check did not authenticate to the delivery provider.
Credential rotation was scheduled, with no execution record included.

hypotheses.text: An invalid, expired, revoked or misconfigured credential could explain the authentication failures.
gaps: The provider reason code, expiry and revocation state are unavailable.

missingInformation.text: Whether the credential expired is unknown.
missingInformation.whyItMatters: HTTP 401 alone does not distinguish expiry from other authentication failures.
missingInformation.nextCheck: Check provider-side expiry, revocation, scope and worker configuration.

missingInformation.text: Recovery and rotation completion are unknown.
missingInformation.whyItMatters: A scheduled rotation does not establish a successful authenticated delivery.
missingInformation.nextCheck: Collect a rotation audit event and a later delivery result.

missingInformation.text: Affected-recipient count, message loss and total duration are unknown.
missingInformation.whyItMatters: A queue-depth sample cannot establish these impact measures.
missingInformation.nextCheck: Inspect message outcomes and the wider incident window.

nextChecks.text: Inspect provider-side credential status and worker configuration.
nextChecks.rationale: The export omits expiry and revocation state; the runbook lists additional authentication checks.

nextChecks.text: After any approved rotation, verify authenticated delivery and queue progress.
nextChecks.rationale: Rotation is only scheduled and the existing health probe checks liveness alone.
